title: Actor create — mutator round-trip with gate

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Editor open on the demo project with the bridge answering ping. The current level is one you are willing to mutate transiently — the default editor map is fine; the scenario spawns one actor and destroys it in cleanup. The spawn uses a native class (PointLight) so no Blueprint asset dependency is required. Pick a run-unique actor label (e.g. suffix with a timestamp or counter) so repeated runs do not collide; the cleanup + reset destroy by that same label.

steps.title: Spawn a PointLight via the bridge (deterministic staging)
Spawn a PointLight in the MCP client (observe the gate)
Expected outcomes
items: The actor spawns: the result carries the new actor's path / name and no isError flag.
The actor is visible in the current level (outliner + viewport).
When the gate is enforced, gate.validation.passed is true and gate.delta.newErrors is 0 (spawning a native PointLight introduces no verify issues).
Result metadata carries _source: "live" (actor_create routes to the running bridge).
A single editor undo (or the cleanup destroy) removes the spawned actor.

steps.title: Paste the agent output (actor_create + actor_destroy envelopes)

reset.note: Cleanup is a best-effort destroy of the spawned actor by its label. If the label was changed for this run, reset the matching actor; the level itself is never modified beyond the single spawn.
